Thanks for sharing an idea! The more context you give about the underlying
workflow, the better we can design a solution that helps IRB staff.

## Problem / use case

What problem are you trying to solve, or what workflow is harder than it should
be today? Describe the scenario rather than jumping straight to a solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like the extension to do? Describe the behavior or UI you have in
mind.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches, workarounds, or existing tools you've tried.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps — mockups, links, related Cayuse behavior, or examples.
Please keep any examples free of real participant/PII data.
